messages:
Olivia Rivera: Quick sync with @Maria and @Sam about Acme onboarding SLA expectations — they asked for a monthly latency report and clarity on credit calculation for a 99.95% uptime miss. Can someone confirm next steps?

Maria Chen: I can own the monthly report. Need access to their workspace and to confirm metric defs (p95 vs p99). Also what exact window do we use for credit calc (per-minute, per-incident)?

Sam Patel: Engineering note: Contract defines 99.95% uptime per calendar month. For credits we typically prorate by the percentage below SLO across the month. I will confirm the legal/finance calc. Quick question — are we also aligning on latency SLO?

Olivia Rivera: Yes — Acme's onboarding addendum lists p95 latency <= 250ms for hosted text-gen routes. They want the 30-day historical report and to know if they qualify for a one-off credit for last month. Renewal is in ~6 weeks so they want resolution before renewal review.

Maria Chen: I'll draft the report template and a short explainer for the credit calc. Aiming to deliver Thu EOD. @Luis can you pull the latency/uptime telemetry for the last 30 days and include incident windows? Use the query: `service:api AND env:prod | summarize p95(latency) by day`

Luis Gomez: On it. ETA Wed AM. Will attach a CSV with daily p95, downtime minutes, and any incident IDs. Note: there were two infra incidents on Mar 2 (region failover) and Mar 18 (storage degradation) that may affect numbers.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot posted a system note at 1837502234 — Canary rollout completed for model-route v2.2 in us-west-2.

Sam Patel: After Luis' data, I recommend we propose a one-time goodwill credit option (tiered) to avoid escalation at renewal. I'll sync with Finance for an amount range tied to X% below SLO. Also will verify clause reference (SLA §4.2 credit calculation).

Maria Chen: Agree. I'll prepare two artifacts: 1) SLA report (CSV + one-page summary) and 2) proposed credit calculation + suggested dollar figure ranges. Will link both in the customer tracker and drop a draft here.

Olivia Rivera: Perfect. I'll update the Acme CSM and request a short call for Thu 10:00am PDT to walk through the report. Please flag any blockers. :thumbsup:

Sam Patel: FYI engineering will include a short appendix describing failover behavior so the customer understands why those incidents impacted availability.

Luis Gomez: Uploading raw logs and the CSV to the shared folder now. Will ping when done.

Olivia Rivera: Thanks team — this should help close the renewal risk. If anything urgent, call me.
